summary: ICICI Bank Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting receipt of a show cause notice under Section 73 of the West Bengal Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 from the Joint Commissioner of Revenue, West Bengal, dated today at 11:29 a.m. The notice asserts GST demand of INR 16,75,96,536 (tax INR 9,30,73,770; interest INR 6,52,15,388; penalty INR 93,07,378) on services to customers maintaining specified minimum balances. The bank is litigating similar past matters and will reply within prescribed timelines. No board recommendation, advisor, price, or structural terms; this is a regulatory tax disclosure, not a special situation.
